messages:
Alex: Heads-up — I opened PR for the 2.3.1 merge window, needs a quick review and a changelog line. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8422 :wave:
Maria: taking a look now, will check tests and changelog.
Jevon: I can do a perf skim if you want, Alex. is this low-risk?
Alex: low-risk bugfix in batching logic, affects edge case on KV cache expiry. No schema changes. Should be safe for backport.
Samir: @Maria @Jevon fyi I noticed we need a backport to release/2.3-stable if we cut this. I'll prep the branch once PR approved.
Maria: tests flaky locally for one of the integration cases, re-running CI.
release-bot: CI started for runtime#8422 — linux-integration, unit, lint. ETA ~15m.
Cheng: quick note — add a one-line changelog under Unreleased > Fixes, e.g. `Fix KV cache expiry causing duplicate tokens in rare tail cases (#8422)`
Alex: added changelog snippet in PR description and pushed a tiny commit with changelog file.
Jevon: skim looks fine. two nits inline but nothing blocking. Will approve after CI green. :thumbsup:
Maria: CI passed on rerun. unit + lint good, integration x2 passed.
Samir: tagging for backport: will create backport PR once merged. ping me if you prefer I do it pre-emptively.
Jevon: leaving an approval comment now.
Alex: thanks everyone — can someone hit merge when you see the green merge window? I won't be at the cut time. cc @Samir for backports. :rocket:
Maria: will merge at T-30 if no regressions.
release-bot: Label `release-ready` applied by release-bot.
Samir: noted, I'll watch backport flow and open the stable PR after merge.
Cheng: LGTM — merging when you say go, Maria.
Maria: merging now. :hammer:
Alex: great, thanks all!
Samir: backport PR queued: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8430 — assigning reviewers.
Alex: perfect, closing loop. :white_check_mark:
